example.title: Return shared errors for a missing greeting and invalid input
description: Each example is a separate project. All required application files appear in the tabs.
Both named files belong in `src/main/java/com/example/demo/` beside `DemoApplication`.
The package-private `GreetingNotFoundException` belongs in the same file as the controller.
The example has one fixed greeting with ID `1`. It does not depend on an unshown database or service.
The commands run after the application restarts and assume port `8080`.
`mvn spring-boot:run` starts the application from the directory containing `pom.xml`. Requests run in a second terminal.
explanation: The first request raises `GreetingNotFoundException` and the advice returns `404`.
Its problem body includes `detail` with `Greeting was not found`.
The second request fails `@NotBlank` before the controller runs.
The validation handler returns `400` with a `fields` array containing `name`.
Only field names are included. The response does not copy rejected values.
The same advice can handle matching failures from other controllers.
example.commands:
curl -i http://localhost:8080/greetings/99
curl -i -X POST http://localhost:8080/greetings \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name":" "}'
